manual_measurements.method: Manual pixel readings from native-resolution drawing crops, not coordinates generated from VPW. Affine least-squares reconciliation uses four bumper centres and two flipper pivots. Derived coordinates are rounded to three decimals and remain observed. Lamp readings identify the centre of the numbered location symbol; they do not claim sub-bulb precision.

projections.coil_effect: Mechanism effect anchor from the script binding, not the winding centre.
projections.door_sensors: Switches 41/42 share the DSDoor mesh anchor; projected mechanism location, not measured sensor hardware.
projections.flashers: 1R uses the three upper Lights, dropping lower co-located glows; 2R uses the smallest local falloff Light f2r; 3R uses f3r_a/b; 4R uses f128d_l and f4r_a/b/c. The manual supports these playfield regions, not full bank quantities. 6R uses the two drawing symbols. Back-panel and insert-panel bulbs are not playfield placements. Printed 4R and 6R totals disagree with their location annotations.
projections.gi: The 17 Lights in the GI collection are observed only. The table's grouping does not establish factory wiring or quantity.
projections.outhole: Switch 10 and solenoid 1 use Drain: the manual names the separate outhole, and the script's SolIn effect and trough-entry event use Drain. The virtual trough's four-switch array is not four physical trough contacts.
projections.shared_rotation_drive: Solenoid 15's observed anchor is the Death Star; its second R2D2 motor is documented in the combined mechanism but lacks a separately verified motor/effect position.
projections.trough: Switches 11-13 share BallRelease from the scripted trough; projected assembly anchor, not three measured contacts. Solenoid 2 uses the ball-release effect anchor.
